## DESIGN INVESTIGATION (pre-claim): regression theory refuted; fix architecture converged; live derisking experiments in flight

### Regression claim tested and REFUTED
Hypothesis raised in review: this is a regression from the LLM provider-seam epic (f184 07-29 / 2932 07-30). Git archaeology refutes it: the schema-blind selection dates to b82d23f6 (06-21); all four prior instance-fixes landed 07-05..07-07, three weeks BEFORE the seam epic; pre-epic output_mode() already excluded Anthropic from native output (allowlist {openai, google-gla, google-vertex, groq}), so Claude took the identical prompted path under both seams. The seam epic is behavior-preserving for Claude BY DESIGN. What the migration DID change is trigger rate, not the defect: 2932 (07-30) swapped the verifier onto bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 (different formatting distribution), and b586's re-parenting created the first dep-quoting occasion. The July "mitigated period" was instance-pins holding + low exposure, not a closed class.

### OSS prior art (researched with citations, agents' full reports in session artifacts
- pydantic_ai PromptedOutput extraction is SCHEMA-BLIND FIRST-FENCE (strip_markdown_fences) — same defect class; adopting it as output_type is REJECTED on four verified grounds (same defect relocated; breaks the pinned one-call-repair contract — no pre-validation heal hook; loses per-attempt truncation/refusal fast-fail; injects schema as static instruction, reordering our cache prefix split).
- instructor (+deepeval/ragas/guardrails-ai/promptfoo) switched to LAST-valid-object as a prompt-injection security fix: quoted material precedes the model's authoritative answer.
- BAML SAP is the only schema-aware selector, but its equal-score tiebreak is FIRST-in-text-order — it degenerates on exactly our failure shape (two schema-valid candidates); its graded coercion (DefaultFromNoValue penalty-100 still returns a filled object) is a false-accept risk unacceptable for a gate.
- Why nobody combines schema-filter + position: never proposed anywhere (not tried-and-failed); maintainers bet on provider-native output; Pydantic binary validation makes scoring costly. Novelty interrogated and explained.

### Provider matrix finding — structured.py's premise is STALE
The historic Anthropic 400 was tool_choice-x-thinking, NOT structured-output-x-thinking. Anthropic output_config.format (grammar-constrained JSON) is explicitly thinking-compatible; pydantic_ai 1.107.1 auto-promotes to native when thinking is on and the profile supports json_schema output. bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 has a GA NativeOutput path on Converse (also haiku-4-5; opus-4-7/4-8 are EXCLUDED from Converse structured output — the prompted path stays load-bearing for them permanently). Only rebar's _REBAR_OVERRIDES (_is_claude -> native_structured_output False) and output_mode()'s thinking-forces-prompted guard block it. Revisiting that override is a signed-contract change requiring live measurement — experiment E1 below.

### Converged fix architecture (all layers IN SCOPE for this epic, per operator decision)
1. LAYER 1 — provider-native where measured: live-prove NativeOutput+thinking on Bedrock sonnet-4-6/haiku-4-5, then narrow _REBAR_OVERRIDES per measured cell (exact-id override table is the established mechanism) and fix output_mode()'s stale thinking guard. Keep validator bounds client-side (grammar strips min/max on Bedrock).
2. LAYER 2 — prompted-path hardening (permanent for Bedrock opus + fallback everywhere): (a) sentinel channel in schema_directive (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>...<<<END>>>, LAST block wins), tried before today's pipeline; (b) schema-filtered selection in parse_structured (NOT tolerant_parse — its schema param already means json-repair guidance): enumerate all top-level non-overlapping objects (cap 32) + fenced blocks, key-overlap screen against model_cls.model_fields (required: all-defaults schemas like OverlapVerdict validate {}), full validate_to per candidate, LAST-valid-wins (position-authority principle, consistent with sentinel layer), warn when >=2 validate and last!=first; on no winner fall back to today's pipeline with improved error attribution (last key-screened candidate's validation error).
3. LAYER 3 — invariant tests: property test (any prose incl. schema-valid decoys + payload rendered last -> payload recovered) + captured-reply corpus + pinned adversarial case; trailing-recap hijack documented as the accepted residual. Opt-in raw-reply artifact on parse failure (respecting usage_log's no-prompt/response-in-durable-records posture).

Accepted residuals (explicit): trailing-recap layout loses under last-wins (zero of five recurrences show it; observable via the ambiguity warning); schema-less tolerant_parse stays first-parseable per its determinism pin (divergence documented).

### Experiments in flight (operator-authorized, sonnet/haiku tiers, Bedrock)
- E1 live: NativeOutput x thinking matrix on Bedrock sonnet-4-6/haiku-4-5 incl. the agentic-tools+thinking+native cell (the verifier's real shape) and a bounds-stripping probe.
- E2 live: sentinel directive compliance, n~26, adversarial df3a-shaped prompt with dep record + early schema-valid decoy; measures current-pipeline failure rate vs sentinel vs schema-filtered-last-valid.
- E3/E4 deterministic: selection prototype vs every pinned test in tests/unit/test_structured.py + property trials + df3a byte-shape reproduction; and whether _repair's schema= (Pydantic CLASS passed to json_repair) actually engages or silently falls back.

Results will be posted here; then the description gets the full plan (with file_impact) -> review-plan -> claim -> implement.
EOF
)
